description: BM25 retrieval over the curated careers dataset, measured on evals/chat-eval.json. A hit means at least one expected passage is among the passages retrieved: the top k, plus every section of any role the question names (up to maxPassages). Retrieval was tuned on the development split only; the heldout split is the number to trust. The gate rows show how many non-answerable questions retrieval alone rejects; the rest rely on the model abstaining.
